effective_date_basis: A current basis checked through 2026-10-14 (refuge system records, later orders or PLOs), or the revoking instrument's date.
ending_pattern: Reservation for birds or wildlife: continues until revoked; many became units of the National Wildlife Refuge System and may still be in force (a YES needing a current basis). Enlargements and diminutions change the area, not the reservation's existence.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Later statutes (for example the National Wildlife Refuge System Administration Act of 1966) may continue the area independently. Transfer of the administering bureau (Biological Survey to Interior, Reorganization Plan No. II of 1939) and renaming (redesignation as National Wildlife Refuges in 1940; verify) are continuities, not ends.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.

Lands acquired by purchase under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act ('acquired or to be acquired', as in the exemplar) are not public-domain withdrawals: their federal status rests on title, not on the order.
The refuge was later re-established, consolidated or absorbed under another name or statute (the order is superseded, the area continues).
The area was transferred to a state or another agency by statute or exchange.
